fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics publishes GDP, CPI, PPI, trade and survey reports with microdata for download at gbosdata.org/downloads; no licence is stated.

The Gambia Bureau of Statistics runs a microdata catalogue that, as of 2 July 2026, holds three survey studies (MICS 2000, DHS 2019-2020, Labour Force Survey 2018), the latest entries dated June and July 2025.
